test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate title of the passage.

options.text: The Role of the Supreme Court

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Explanation:** The passage discusses the topic of judicial activism in India, highlighting the significant role of the judiciary, particularly the Supreme Court, in shaping laws and ensuring justice.
 
• It also addresses the debates surrounding the extent of judicial power and the balance between judicial activism and restraint.
 
• This makes** "The Debate over Judicial Activism"** the most appropriate title for the passage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Constitutional Principles in India:** While the passage does touch on constitutional principles, its main focus is on judicial activism and its implications, not on constitutional principles in a broader sense.
 
• **The Preamble of India:** The passage does not discuss the preamble of the Indian Constitution specifically; therefore, this title is not suitable.
 
• **The Role of the Supreme Court:** Although the Supreme Court's role is mentioned, the passage is more focused on the broader issue of judicial activism rather than just the Supreme Court's role.
